title: Shopify Theme Section Notes
description: Per-page human-authored annotations for section implementation. Lives at harness/notes/<page-key>.json, sibling-discovered by the page-key carried in the source-manifest. Section agents must read it before implementing; harness validation enforces that declared interaction patterns are matched by the actual implementation.

pageKey.description: Must match the source-manifest figmaPage.id and the file's basename (harness/notes/<pageKey>.json).

sourceManifestPath.description: Optional. Repo-relative path to the matching figma/<page-key>/source-manifest.json so reviewers can navigate from notes back to source.

sections.description: Sparse: only sections that need a human override or prompt need an entry. Sections absent from this array fall back to source-manifest defaults.

id.description: Must match a section id in the source-manifest.

implementationPolicy.description: Human override. Wins over source-manifest.implementationPolicy when present.

recommendedSkill.description: Repo-relative skill path. Use to force a section onto a different skill than source-manifest's classifier picked.

agentPrompt.description: Free-form human-authored prompt for the implementing agent. The agent must read it verbatim, mirror it into section-task.brief, and reference its sha256 in section-result.notesAcknowledged. The agent is not allowed to paraphrase or shorten.

humanNotes.description: Provenance / explanatory bullets for future readers. Agent reads but does not act on.
